a: Rabbi shimon omer: kevan shennizrak alav echad min haddamim — huttar hannazir lishtot beyayin ulehittamme lemetim.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "veachar yishte hannazir yayin" — achar hammaasim kullan, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: achar maase yechidi.
May tamayyhu derabbanan? ketiv hacha "veachar yishte hannazir yayin", uchetiv hatam "achar hitgallecho et nizro". ma hatam "achar" — maase yechidi, af kan "achar" — maase yechidi.
Ema ad deikka tarvavyyhu! i hachi, gezera shava lema li?
Amar rav: tenufa benazir meakkevet. allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbanan — tiglachat amri rabbanan la meakkeva, tenufa mibbaya?
Ella allibba derabbi eliezer — peshita, haamar rabbi eliezer: achar maasim kullam! mahu detema: kevan dilinyan kappara sheyare mitzva hi, hacha name la teakkev, ka mashma lan.
b: Ume meakkeva? vehatanya: "zot torat hannazir", ben sheyyesh lo kappayim, ben sheen lo kappayim!

Veella ha detanya: "zot torat hannazir", ben sheyyesh lo sear, ben sheen lo sear — hachi name dela meakkeva? vehatanya: nazir memorat, bet shammay omrim: eno tzarich lehaavir taar al rosho, uvet hillel omrim: tzarich lehaavir taar al rosho.
Veamar ravina: may "eno tzarich" levet shammay: eno tzarich — en lo takkana. ha levet hillel yesh lo takkana!
Vehayeynu derabbi pedat. deamar rabbi pedat: bet shammay verabbi eliezer amru davar echad.
May rabbi eliezer, detanya: en lo bohen yad varegel — en lo tohora olamit, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi shimon omer: yannichennu al mekomo veyetze. vachachamim omrim: yanniach al shel semol veyetze.

Lishshana acharina amri la, amar rav: tenufa benazir meakkevet. allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbi eliezer — peshita, haamar rabbi eliezer achar maasim kullam! ella allibba derabbanan: hasheta yesh lomar tiglachat amri rabbanan la meakkeva, tenufa mibbaya?

Umi la meakkeva? vehatanya: "zot torat hannazir" — ben sheyyesh lo kappayim uven sheen lo kappayim! veella ha detanya: "zot torat hannazir" — ben sheyyesh lo sear uven sheen lo sear, hachi name dimakkeva?
Vehatanya: nazir memorat, bet shammay omrim: eno tzarich lehaavir taar al rosho, uvet hillel omrim: tzarich! amar rabbi avina: may "tzarich" levet hillel — tzarich, veen lo takkana,
Levet shammay yesh lo takkana. ufeliga derabbi pedat.

Mishna gillach al hazzevach, venimtza pasul — tiglachto pesula, uzevachav lo alu lo. gillach al hachattat shello lishmah, veachar kach hevi korbenotav lishman, tiglachto pesula, uzevachav lo alu lo. gillach al haola o al hashshelamim shello lishman, veachar kach hevi korbenotav lishman — tiglachto pesula, uzevachav lo alu lo.
Rabbi shimon omer: oto hazzevach lo ala lo, aval shear zevachim alu. veim gillach al shelashtan, venimtza echad mehen kasher — tiglachto keshera, veyavi shear zevachim.

Gemara amar rav adda bar ahava: zot omeret, kasavar rabbi shimon: nazir sheggillach al shalme nedava yatza. may tama? deamar kera: "venatan al haesh asher tachat zevach hashshelamim", velo katav "al shelamav".

a: Mishna mi shennizrak alav echad min haddamim venitma, rabbi eliezer omer: soter et hakkol. vachachamim omrim: yavi shear korbenotav veyithar. amru lo: maase bemiryam hattarmodit shennizrak aleha echad min haddamim, uvau veamru lah al bittah shehayta mesukkenet, vehalcha umatza shemmeta. veamru chachamim: tavi shear korbenoteha vetithar.
Gemara katane, rabbi eliezer omer: soter et hakkol. vehaamar rabbi eliezer: kol achar melot shiva soter! amar rav: may "soter" name dekaamar rabbi eliezer — soter korbenotav.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane: vachachamim omrim tavi shear korbenoteha vetithar, shema minna.

Umaase name bemiryam hattarmodit shennezarek aleha echad min haddamim, uvau vehodiuha al bittah shehayta mesukkenet, vehalcha umatza shemmeta, veamru chachamim: tavi shear korbenoteha vetithar. shema minna.
Haderan alach shelosha minin

Kohen gadol venazir en mittammein likrovehen, aval mittammein lemet mitzva. hayu mehallechin badderech umatzu met mitzva — rabbi eliezer omer: yittamme kohen gadol, veal yittamme nazir. vachachamim omrim: yittamme nazir, veal yittamme kohen hedyot.

Amar lahem rabbi eliezer: yittamme kohen — sheeno mevi korban al tumeato, veal yittamme nazir — shehu mevi korban al tumeato. amru lo: yittamme nazir — sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam, veal yittamme kohen — shekkedushshato kedushshat olam.
Gemara bishlama kohen gadol venazir, hay savar: kohen gadol adif, vehay savar: nazir adif.
Mashuach beshemen hammishcha
b: Umerubbe vegadim — mashuach beshemen hammishcha adif, deillu mashuach beshemen hammishcha — mevi par habba al kol hammitzvot, veillu merubbe vegadim — en mevi.
Mashuach sheavar umerubbe vegadim — merubbe vegadim adif, dimrubbe vegadim — aved avoda, veillu mashuach sheavar — lav bar avoda hu.
Avar mechamat keruyo veavar mechamat mumo — avar mechamat keruyo adif, deillu hay chazi laavoda lemachar, veillu avar mechamat mumo lo chazi laavoda.
Ibbaya lehu: meshuach milchama usegan, he minnayyhu adif? meshuach milchama adif — dachaze lemilchama, o dilma segan adif — dachaze laavoda?
Ta shema, detanya: en ben meshuach milchama lisgan, ella sheim hayu mehallechin bederech umatzu met mitzva — yittamme meshuach milchama veal yittamme hassegan.
Vehatanya: meshuach milchama kodem lisgan! amar mar zutera: leinyan hachayoto — meshuach milchama adif, may tama — ditlu beh rabbim,
Uleinyan tumea segan adif. detanya, rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: lamma tikkenu segan lechohen gadol — sheim era bo pesul hare nichnas umeshammesh tachtav.
Ad kan la peligi ella bechohen gadol venazir ki ka azli bahade hadade, aval chad chad lechodeh bar ittammoye innun. mena hane mille?

Detanu rabbanan: "al kol nafshot met lo yavo", bamma hakkatuv medabber? i birchokim — kal vachomer hu: uma kohen hedyot shehu mittamme likrovim eno mittamme lirchokim, kohen gadol sheeno mittamme likrovim, eno din sheeno mittamme lirchokim? ella bikrovim hakkatuv medabber.
Uleaviv hu deeno mittamme, ha mittamme hu lemet mitzva.

a: "Uleimmo" — ligzera shava, lechidrabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: gabbe nazir "bemotam" eno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lenigam ulezivatam. veen li ella benazir, bechohen gadol minnayin?

Amarta: lo yeamer "immo" bechohen gadol, sheen talmud lomar, shehare kal vachomer hu: uma im bemakom shekkohen hedyot mittamme leachiv meaviv — en kohen gadol mittamme leaviv, makom sheen kohen hedyot mittamme leachiv meimmo — eno din sheen kohen gadol mittamme leimmo?
Im zachita mehaddin, ma talmud lomar "immo" bechohen gadol? mufene lehakkish veladun hemennu gezera shava: neemar "immo" benazir, veneemar "immo" bechohen gadol,
Ma "immo" haamur benazir — bemotam eno mittamme aval mittamme hu lenigam ulezivatam, af "immo" haamur bechohen gadol — bemotam eno mittamme aval mittamme lenigam ulezivatam.
Ashkechan kohen gadol. nazir menalan? detanya: "kol yeme hazziro laAdonai al nefesh met lo yavo",

Shomea ani afillu nefesh behema bammashma, keinyan shenneemar "makke nefesh behema", talmud lomar: "al nefesh met lo yavo", benefesh adam hakkatuv medabber. rabbi yishmael omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "lo yavo" — binfashot hametammeot bevia hakkatuv medabber.
"Leaviv uleimmo" eno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva.
Ad shello yeamer, yesh li baddin: uma kohen gadol shekkedushshato kedushshat olam, mittamme lemet mitzva, nazir sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam — eno din shemmittamme lemet mitzva?

Lo: im amarta bechohen gadol, shekken eno mevi korban al tumeato, tomar benazir, shemmevi korban al tumeato. hoil umevi korban al tumeato lo yittamme lemet mitzva? talmud lomar: "leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma", aval mittamme lemet mitzva.

O: eno mittamme leaviv uleimmo, aval yittamme lishar metim! amarta kal vachomer: uma kohen hedyot, shemmittamme likrovin — eno mittamme lishar metim, nazir, sheeno mittamme likrovin — eno din shello yittamme lishar metim?
b: Ha ma talmud lomar "leaviv uleimmo", leaviv uleimmo hu delo mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva.

Ad shello yeamer yesh li baddin: neemru kelalot bechohen gadol, veneemru kelalot benazir. ma kelalot haamurot bechohen gadol — leaviv eno mittamme, aval mittamme lemet mitzva, af kelalot haamurot benazir — leaviv eno mittamme, aval mittamme lemet mitzva.
O kelach lederech zo: neemru kelalot bechohen hedyot, veneemru kelalot benazir. ma kelalot haamurot bechohen hedyot — mittamme leaviv, af kelalot haamurot benazir — mittamme leaviv.
Talmud lomar: "leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma", ha lemet mitzva mittamme. ha mibbee leh lomar sheen mittamme leaviv?
Ella: "leaviv" — lomar sheen mittamme leaviv. "leachiv" eno mittamme — ha lemet mitzva mittamme. "uleimmo" — ligzera shava, lechidrabbi.
"Uleachoto", lechidtanya. detanya: "leachoto" ma talmud lomar?
Hare shehalach lishchot et pischo velamul et beno, veshama shemmet lo met — yachol yittamme? amarta: "lo yittamme".
Yachol lo yittamme lemet mitzva, talmud lomar: "leachoto" — laachoto hu deeno mittamme, ha lemet mitzva — mittamme.
Rabbi akiva omer: "nefashot" — ellu harchokin, "met" — ellu hakkerovin, "leaviv uleimmo" eno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva.
"Leachiv" — sheim haya kohen gadol vehu nazir, leachiv eno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva. "leachoto", kidtanya: hare shehaya holech lishchot et pischo velamul et beno kulei.
Ulerabbi akiva, gezera shava derabbi, menaleh?
Amar lach: kevan deamar mar im haya kohen gadol venazir, leachiv eno mittamme, aval mittamme hu lemet mitzva — ma li kohen gadol lechodeh, ma li nazir vechohen gadol.
Ulerabbi yishmael, kohen gadol vehu nazir menaleh? kevan dishra rachamana chad lav gabbe met mitzva — ma li chad lav, ma li teren lavin.
"Achoto" lema li? salka datach amena ki shera rachamana lemet mitzva — nazir vechohen, deissur lave hu. aval mila ufesach, decharet — lo yittamme lemet mitzva, ka mashma lan.

a: Ulerabbi akiva, mikkede la shena kohen gadol lechodeh vela shena kohen gadol vehu nazir, nafka milleachiv", "leaviv uleimmo" lema li?
Tzerichi: dei ketav "aviv", hava amena: hayeynu tama dela mittamme leh — mishshum dachazaka bealma hu. aval immo deyadin diledteh — litamme la.
Vei ketav rachamana "immo", hava amena: immo la litamme la, delav azel zara batra. aval aviv, kevan deamar mar "lemishpechotam levet avotam", ema litamme leh — ka mashma lan.
"Veal kol nafshot met lo yavo", lema li?
b: "Al kol" — leappoke rechokim, "met" — leappoke kerovim, "nafshot" — leappoke reviit dam sheyyatza mishshene metim, shemmetamme beohel, shenneemar: "al kol nafshot met lo yavo".

Mishna al ellu tumeot hannazir megalleach: al hammet, veal kezayit min hammet, veal kezayit netzel, veal melo tarvod rakav. al hashshidra, veal haggulegolet, veal ever min hammet, veal ever min hachay sheyyesh alav basar karauy, veal chatzi kav atzamot, veal chatzi log dam.
Veal maggaan veal massaan veal ahilan. veal etzem kisora al maggao veal massao.
Al ellu hannazir megalleach, umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii vesoter et hakkodmin, veeno matchil limnot ella ad sheyyithar umevi et korbenotav.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: achar petirato shel rabbi meir amar lahen rabbi yehuda letalmidav: al yikkansu talmide rabbi meir lechan, mippene shekkanteranin hen, velo lilmod tora hen bain, ella lekappecheni bahalachot hen bain. dachak somchos venichnas.

Amar lahem, kach shana li rabbi meir: al ellu tumeot hannazir megalleach: al hammet, veal kazzayit min hammet. kaas rabbi yehuda veamar lahen, lo kach amarti lachem: al yikkansu talmide rabbi meir lechan, mippene shekkanteranin hen? al kazzayit min hammet megalleach — al hammet lo kol shekken?!

a: Amar rabbi yose: yomru meir shachav, yehuda kaas, yose shatak — tora ma tehe aleha? amar rabbi yose: lo nitzrecha ella lemet sheen alav kezayit basar. vaadayin yomar: al ever mimmennu megalleach, al kullo lo kol shekken?!
Ella, kidamar rabbi yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella lenefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin. hacha name: benefel shello nitkashsheru evarav begidin.
Rava amar: lo nitzrecha ella lerov binyayno ulerov minyayno, sheen bahen rova atzamot.
Al kezayit met veal kezayit netzel. veezehu netzel — besar hammet shekkarash, umohal shehirtiach.
Hechi dame? illema dela yadinan dedideh hu, ki karash may have? ella deyadinan dedideh hu, af al gav delo karash!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: bistam. i karash — mohel hu, lo karash — dilma kicho venio hu.
Bea minneh abbaye merabba: yesh netzel livhema o en netzel livhema? mi amrinan gemiri netzel deate meadam, aval deate mibbehema — la. o dilma la shena?
Hanicha leman deamar tumea chamura ad leger, vetumea kalla ad lechelev — shappir.
Ella leman deamar tumea chamura ad lechelev, may ikka lememar?
Ta shema: himchuhu baur — tame, bachamma — tahor. vei salka datach ad lechelev, afillu bachamma name!
Emat mamche leh — batar deasrach bechamma, kevan deasrach — have leh afar.
Tenan: kol hannitztzok — tahor.
Chutz middevash hazzifim vehatztzappichit.
b: Bet shammay omrim: af hammikpa shel gerisin veshel pol, mippene shehi soledet laachoreha.
Bae rame bar chama: yesh nitztzok laochalin, o en nitztzok laochalin. mi amrinan mishshum deit behu rire, vehane let behu rire. o dilma mishshum dismichin hu, vehacha ha semichin?
Amar rava, ta shema: chelev hammet shehu shalem vehitticho — tame, haya meforad vehitticho — tahor. vei salka datach en nitztzok laochalin, shalem vehitticho name lithar!
Amar rabbi zera: ana umar bereh deravina targemna: hacha bemay askinan — kegon devahade demartach leh, salek ammuda denura lefummeh demana vekaresh, deiteh kulle gabbe hadade.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, ta shema: bet shammay omrim: af hammikpa shel gerisin veshel pol — mippene shehen soldin laachorehen. midde irya? hatam, mishshum dismichin. hacha, mishshum rire.

Veal melo tarvod rakav. vechamma shiuro? chizkiyya amar: melo pissat hayyad, rabbi yochanan amar: melo chofnav. tenan: melo tarvod rakav sheamru, yeshnan meikkar etzbaot ulemala, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: melo chofnav.
Bishlama rabbi yochanan hu deamar kerabbanan. ella chizkiyya keman? la kerabbi meir vela kerabbanan! amri: melo pissat hayyad umelo kishre etzbeotav lemala — chad shiura hu.
Amar leh rav shimi bar adda lerav pappa: mimmay dehay mikkishre etzbeotav ulemala lerosh? dilma lematta middideh, dehave leh melo pissat hayyad? teku.

a: Tanu rabbanan: ezehu met sheyyesh lo rakav? met shennikbar arom bearon shel shayish o al gabbe ritzpa shel avanim — zehu met sheyyesh lo rakav. nikbar bichsuto, bearon shel etz, o al gabbe ritzpa shel levenim — zehu met sheen lo rakav.

Amar ulla: en rakav, ella habba min habbasar umin haggidim umin haatzamot. etiveh rava leulla: rakav habba min habbasar tahor. ha min haetzem — tame, veaf al gav delekka basar! ema hachi: rakav habba min habbasar — tahor, ad sheyyesh etzem babbasar.
Ha lekka gidim! i efshar levasar velaatzamot belo gidim.
Amar rav shemuel bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: shene metim shekkevaran ze im ze — naasu galgallin ze laze. metiv rav natan: rakav habba mishshene metim — tame!
Amar rava: shekkavru ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo, vehirkivu, veamdu al melo tarvod rakav.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: gazaz searo ukevaro immo — naasa lo galgallin. tenan hatam: kol shebbammet tame, chutz min hashshinnayim vehassear vehatztzipporen. uvishat chibburan — kullan temein.
Bae chizkiyya: searo haomed legalleach, tzipporen haomed liggazez, may? mi amrinan: kol haomed liggazez kegazuz dame, o dilma hasheta miha ha mechubbarin?
Venifshot leh midderabba bar bar chana: tama mishshum degazaz, ha lo gazaz — la! hachi kaamar: gazaz — hare ze galgallim. lo gazaz — mibbee leh.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: rakav habba min heakev mahu? ki gamrinan rakav habba mikkulleh met, aval deate min akev — la, o dilma la shena?
Ta shema, detane rabbi natan berabbi oshaya: rakav habba mishshene metim — tame. vei salka datach habba min heakev la, zil hacha — dilma derech akev kaate, vehacha — dilma derech akev kaate?
I deirkiv kulleh met vekaate derech akev — hachi name. ella hacha kegon deirkiv chad ever, vekaate derech akev. may? teku.

Bae rabbi yirmeya: ubbar bime ishsha, have galgallim, o la? kevan deamar mar ubbar yerech immo — hilkach gufa hu, vela have galgallin, o dilma kevan desofo latzet — mifrash paresh minna. veim timtze lomar ubbar desofo latzet mifrash paresh minna,
b: Shichvat zera bime ishsha, mahu? mi amrinan kevan dela ittetzar — ki gufa dame, o dilma kevan demealma kaate — la?
Bae rav pappa: pirshah, mahu? kevan dela mikkayyma bidla achla — chayyuta hu, o dilma ha name mealma ate? bae rav acha bereh derav ika: oro mahu? bae rav huna bar manoach: kicho venio mahu?
Amar leh rav shemuel bar acha lerav pappa: vei salka datach kol hane dekaamar have galgallin, rakav dimtamme hechi mashkachat la! deashkeyeh me dekalim, vesachye nasha, ushelako beme teverya.

Amar abbaye, naktinan: met shettechano — en lo rakav. ibbaya lehu: techano vechazar vehirkiv, mahu? midde hu tama ella deikka basar vegidim vaatzamot, vehaikka. o dilma kivriyyayto bainan, velekka? teku.
Tane ulla bar chanina: met shechasar — en lo rakav velo tefusa velo shechunat kevarot.
Metivi: lo, im amarta bemet sheyyesh lo rov verova o melo tarvod rakav — tomar bechay, sheen lo lo rov, velo rova, velo melo tarvod rakav?!
Hechi dame — dearkiv chad ever, dichvoteh gabbe met: afillu chad ever ikka rakav! mi katane ha met? ha ka mashma lan: shum met — yesh lo rakav, shum chay — en lo rakav.
Bae rava: hirkiv keshehu chay, vechazar umet, mahu? ki gemiri rakav, deirkiv keshehu met. o dilma hasheta miha ha mayet?
Ta shema: lo im amarta bemet sheyyesh lo rov verova umelo tarvod rakav, tomar bechay kulei.
Tama mishshum chay, ha met yesh lo rakav! mi katane ha met? ha ka mashma lan deshum met — yesh lo rakav, shum chay — en lo rakav.
Bae rava: nemala shechasra, mahu? shiura gemirin la — veha chasar. o beriyya gemiri la — vehaikka.

a: Amar rav yehuda middiskarta: ta shema: "bahem", yachol bechullan — talmud lomar: "mehem". i "mehem", yachol miktzatan — talmud lomar: "bahem".
Ha ketzad? ad sheyyigga bemiktzatan shehu kechullan. veshiaru chachamim bechaadasha, shekken hachomet techillat beriyyayto bechaadasha. shema minna shiura gemiri la.
Amar rav shemaya: ki bainan shiura devidla havya kaadasha la metamma, dela nafla ba neshama. aval nafla ba neshama — la. tibbee lach.

Hashshidra vehaggulegolet. ibbaya lehu: shidra vegulegolet tenan, o dilma: o shidra o gulegolet? amar rava: ta shema: shidra sheggerad rov ilin shebbah — tehora. uvekever afillu meshubberet o meforeket — temea, mippene hakkever.
Tama mishshum degerad, ha la gerad — tame, shema minna: o shidra o gulegolet katane. ha la katane. ha ka mashma lan: dechi gerad — tehora, iddach, tibbee lach.

Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: shishsha devarim rabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin, vechazar bo rabbi akiva. umaase sheheviu kuppa melea atzamot levet hakkeneset shel tarsiyyim, vehinnichuha baavir, venichnas todos harofe vechol harofim [immo], veamru: en kan shidra mimmet echad.

Tama delekka shidra demechada. haikka o shidra o gulegolet demechada — nazir megalleach aleha, shema minna o shidra o gulegolet tenan. la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya shidra vegulegolet, demimmet echad lekka, ella afillu o shidra mimmet echad o gulegolet mimmet echad lekka.

Ta shema mimminyayna: uma hen shishsha devarim sherabbi akiva metamme vachachamim metaharin: al ever min hammet shebba mishshene metim, veal ever min hachay shebba mishshene bene adam, veal chatzi kav atzamot shebba mishshene metim, veal reviit dam habba mishshenayim, veal etzem kisora shennechlak lishnayim, vehashshidra vehaggulegolet.
b: Vei salka datach o shidra o gulegolet, hane shiva havyayn! ki katane (siman: yachid, shehu, gillach, veechad) —
Kol hecha difligi aleh rabbim. leappoke etzem kisora, deyachid hu diflig aleh. detanya: etzem kisora shennechlak lishnayim, rabbi akiva metamme verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher.
Vei baet ema: ki katane, ever min hammet, ever min hachay la katane.
Veibbaet ema: ki katane, kol hecha denazir megalleach al ahilo, leappoke etzem kisora dela.
Veibbaet ema: ki katane, kol hecha dahadar beh, leappoke reviit dam dela hadar beh. daamar leh rabbi levar kappara: lo tishne reviit dam bachazara, shehare limmudo shel rabbi akiva beyado.
Veod, hammikra mesayyeyo: "veal kol nafshot met lo yavo". rabbi shimon omer: ad yamav haya metamme, im mishshemmet chazar bo — eni yodea. tana: hushecharu shinnav mippene taaniyyotav.

Ta shema detanya, bet shammay omrim: rova atzamot — min haatzamim o mishshenayim o mishshelosha. uvet hillel omrim: rova min haggeviyya, merov habbinyan o merov hamminyan. amar rabbi yehoshua: yacholni laasot divre bet shammay vedivre bet hillel keechad.

Shebbet shammay omrim: mishshenayim o mishshelosha — o mishshene shokayim veyarech echad, o mishshene yerechayim veshok echad, hoil verov govho shel adam miggova. uvet hillel omrim: min haggeviyya o merov binyan, o merov minyan — hoil veyeshnan bemifreke yadayim veraglayim. shammay omer: afillu etzem min hashshidra o min haggulegolet.

Shane shammay demachmir. lifshot minna: tama devet shammay demachmir, ha rabbanan ad deikka shidra vegulegolet! la, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh deshammay ella beetzem echad deate min hashshidra umin haggulegolet, aval hecha deiteh beeneh, afillu chada minnehon.

Beay rame bar chama: rova atzamot min shidra vegulegolet, may? ki katane chatzi kav atzamot — hecha deikka mishshear evarav, aval min shidra vegulegolet dachamiri — afillu rova atzamot. o dilma la shena?
Amar rava, ta shema: hashshidra vehaggulegolet. vei salka datach rova atzamot deate min shidra vegulegolet chamir — litne: al rova atzamot habba min hashshidra kulei!

a: Veha rava hu deamar: lo nitzrecha ella leshidra vegulegolet sheen bahen rova atzamot! batar deshama merabbi akiva.
Ta shema, shammay omer: etzem echad min shidra o min gulegolet! shane shammay demachmir tefe.
Lifshot minna: tama deshammay, demachmir, ha lerabbanan — ad deikka chatzi kav atzamot!
Dilma ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh deshammay ella beetzem echad, aval berova atzamot — afillu rabbanan modu.

Amar rabbi eliezer: zekenim harishonim, miktzatan hayu omrim: chatzi kav atzamot vachatzi log dam — lakkol. rova atzamot, ureviit dam — lo lakkol. umiktzatan hayu omrim: af rova atzamot ureviit dam — lakkol.
Bet din shelleacharehem amru: chatzi kav atzamot vachatzi log dam — lakkol, rova atzamot ureviit dam — litruma vekadashim. aval lo lenazir veose fesach.
Mikkedi en hacheraat shelishit machraat! amar rabbi yaakov bar idi, mippi shemua amru: mippi chaggay zecharya umalachi.
Al ellu hannazir megalleach. "al ellu" deresha lemaote etzem kisora, deal maggao veal massao — in, veal ahilo — la. veal ellu" desefa — lemaote even hassachochit.
Vachatzi kav atzamot.
b: Chatzi kav atzamot — in, rova atzamot — la. hechi dame? illema deit behon atzamot kisora — tippok leh mishshum etzem kisora! ella deakmach akmoche.
Al ever min hammet veal ever min hachay sheyyesh alehen basar karauy. en alehen basar karauy, may? rabbi yochanan amar: en hannazir megalleach alehen. resh lakish amar: hannazir megalleach alehen.
Rabbi yochanan amar: en hannazir megalleach alehen, deha katane beresha: al ever min hammet veal ever min hachay vechulei sheyyesh alehen kezayit basar — in, aval en alehem — la.
Verabbi shimon ben lakish omer: megalleach. middela katane besefa.
Verabbi yochanan amar lach: kol hecha demashma mikkelala, la katane besefa.
Veha chatzi kav atzamot, demashma chatzi kav atzamot — in, rova atzamot — la, vekatane besefa rova atzamot.
Hatam i lav rova atzamot, hava amena: afillu al maggao veal massao la, lehachi itzterich lemitne rova atzamot, deal ahilan hu deen hannazir megalleach.

Veha chatzi log dam, deshamat minna chatzi log dam — in, reviit dam — la, vekatane besefa reviit dam! hatam, leappoke midderabbi akiva, deamar rabbi akiva: reviit dam habba mishshene metim metamme beohel.

Hay ever min hammet, hechi dame? i deit beh etzem kisora, may tama derabbi yochanan? vei delet beh etzem kisora, may tama deresh lakish? amar lach resh lakish: leolam delet beh etzem kisora, vaafillu hachi rachamana rabbeyeh.
Detanya: "vechol asher yigga al pene hassade bachalal cherev o vemet", "al pene hassade" — ze hammaahil al pene hammet, "bachalal" — ze ever min hachay veyesh lo lehaalot arucha.
"Cherev" hare ze kechalal, "o bemet" — ze ever hanechlal min hammet, "o beetzem adam" — ze rova atzamot, "o bekever" — ze kever satum.

a: Deamar mar: tumea bokaat veola, bokaat veyoredet. veillu gabbe negia, amar rav yehuda, tanya: "(vechol) hannogea baetzem o vechalal", "baetzem" — ze etzem kisora, "o vechalal" — ze ever hanechlal min hachay veen bo lehaalot arucha,
"O bemet" — ze ever hanechlal min hammet, "o vekaver" — amar resh lakish: ze kever shellifne haddibbur.
Hay ever min hammet, hechi dame? i deit beh etzem kisora hayeynu hannogea baetzem! ella delet beh etzem kisora, vaafillu hachi rachamana rabbeyeh!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: leolam deit beh. veim eno inyan lemaggao — tenehu inyan lemassao.
Umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii vesoter vechulei.

Ibbaya lehu: ha dekatane "ad sheyyithar", bashshevii kae — ad deaved heerev shemesh, umanni — rabbi eliezer hi. o dilma bashshemini kae, umay "ad sheyyithar" — ad sheyyavi korbenotav. umanni — rabbanan hi?
Ta shema, middekatane sefa: "matchil umone miyyad", ha resha may "ad sheyyithar" — ad sheyyavi korbenotav, umanni — rabbanan hi deamri: nezirut detohora ad shemini la chayyla.
Mishna aval hassechachot, vehapperaot, uvet happeras,
Veeretz haammim, vehaggolel, vehaddofek, ureviit dam, veohel, verova atzamot, vechelim hannogim bemet, uvime sefaro, uvime gemaro — al ellu en hannazir megalleach.
Umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii,
b: Veeno soter et hakkodmim, umatchil umone miyyad, vekorban en lo. beemet amru: yeme hazzav vehazzava vime hesgero shel metzora, hare ellu olin lo.
Gemara veellu hen hassechachot — ilan hammesech al haaretz. uferaot — hayyotzot min haggader.
Veeretz haammim. ibbaya lehu: eretz haammim, mishshum avvera gazru aleha, o dilma mishshum gushsha gazru aleha?
Ta shema: umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii. vei amrat mishshum avvera, hazzaa lema li?
Ella lav, mishshum gushsha? la, leolam ema lach mishshum avvera, vechi katane — ashsheara.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane: vechelim hannogim bemet. hane kelim bene hazzaa innun? ella shema minna ashsheara.

a: Lema ketannae: hannichnas leeretz haammim beshidda teva umigdal, rabbi metamme, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda metaher. may lav: rabbi savar mishshum avvera, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar mishshum gushsha?
La, dechulle alma mishshum gushsha. mar savar: ohel zaruk — shemeh ohel, umar savar: la shemeh ohel.
Vehatanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: teva shehi melea kelim, uzerakah al pene hammet beohel — temea, veim hayta munnachat — tehora.
Ella: dechulle alma mishshum avvera, umar savar: kevan dela shechicha — la gezaru beh rabbanan, umar savar: af al gav dela shechicha — gezaru beh rabbanan.
Vehattanya: hannichnas leeretz haammim beshidda teva umigdal — tahor, bekaron uvisfina uveiskarya — tame.
Veibbaet ema: hacha shemma yotzi rosho verubbo lesham peligi.
Vehatanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: hannichnas leeretz haammim beshidda teva umigdal — tahor, ad sheyyotzi lesham rosho o rubbo.
Umatchil umone. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella binzirut muetet. aval binzirut merubba — mislak name salkin leh.
Metiv rav sherevya: matchil umone miyyad, veen mevattel bahen et hakkodmin. bemay? ilema binzirut muetet — kavae giddul sear!
b: Ella lav, binzirut merubba, vekatane: matchil umone miyyad! hu motev la vehu mefarek la: binzirut bat chamishshim yom, deyatev esrin, veityelida beh tzaraat. megallach tzarato, vahadar yatev telatin yomin denazir. deha it leh giddul sear.
Metiv rame bar chama: nazir shehaya tame besafek, umuchelat besafek,

a: Ochel bekadashim leachar shishshim yom,
Veshote yayin umittamme lemetim leachar mea veesrim yom.
Vetane ala: bamme devarim amurim — binzirut muetet, aval binzirut bat shana — ochel bekadashim leachar shete shanim.
Veshote yayin umittamme lemetim leachar arba shanim.
Vei salka datach salkin leh yome — tisge leh beshalosh shanim usheloshim yom!

Veod metiv rav ashe: en li ella yeme tumea, sheen olin lo min hamminyan. yeme chilluto, minnayin? vedin hu: yeme tumea — megalleach umevi korban, vime chilluto — megalleach umevi korban. ma yeme tumeato en olin lo min hamminyan — af yeme chilluto en olin lo min hamminyan.
Lo, im amarta bime tumeato — shekken mevattel bahen et hakkodmim, tomar bime chilluto — sheen mevattel bahen et hakkodmin.
Amarta, kal vachomer hu: uma nazir bekever, shessearo rauy letiglachat nezirut, en olin lo min hamminyan. yeme chilluto, sheen searo rauy letiglachat nezirut — lo kol shekken?!
Veen li ella yeme chilluto. yeme sefaro, minnayin? vedin hu:
b: Ma yeme chilluto taun tiglachat — af yeme sefaro. uma yeme chilluto en olin lo min hamminyan — af yeme sefaro.

Yachol af yeme hesgero ken? vehaddin noten: chalut metamme mishkav umoshav, vime hesgero metamme mishkav umoshav. im lamadta lime chilluto sheen olin lo min hamminyan — af yeme hesgero en olin lo min hamminyan.
Amarta: lo, im amarta bime chilluto, shekken chilluto taun tiglachat umevi korban, lefichach en olin. tomar bime hesgero, sheen taun tiglachat, veeno mevi korban, lefichach yaalu lamminyan.
Mikkan amru: yeme sefaro vime gemaro — en olin lo min hamminyan. aval yeme hazzav vehazzava vehesgero shel metzora — hare ellu olin lo.
Katane mihat: la, im amarta bime tumea shekken mevattel bahen et hakkodmin, tomar bime chilluto. bemay? ilema binzirut muetet, ha bainan giddul sear.
Ella lav binzirut merubba, vekatane sheen olin lo min hamminyan. alma la salkin leh! shema minna.

Mishna amar rabbi eliezer mishshum rabbi yehoshua: kol tumea min hammet shennazir megalleach aleha — chayyayvin aleha al biat mikdash. vechol tumea min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha — en chayyayvin aleha al biat mikdash.
Amar rabbi meir: lo tehe zo kalla min hashsheretz.

Gemara verabbi eliezer mishshum rabbi yehoshua gemar la? veha mishshum rabbi yehoshua bar memel gemar lah. detanya, amar rabbi eliezer: keshehalachti leardaskiyya, matzati et rabbi yehoshua ben peter rosh shehaya yoshev vedan lifne rabbi meir bahalacha: kol tumea min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha — chayyayvin aleha mishshum biat mikdash. vechol tumea min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha — en chayyayvin aleha mishshum biat mikdash. amar lo: al tehe zo kalla mishsheretz.

Amarti lo: kelum atta baki berabbi yehoshua bar memel? amar li: hen. kach amar li rabbi yehoshua bar memel mishshum rabbi yehoshua: kol tumea min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha — chayyayv aleha mishshum biat mikdash, vechol tumea min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach aleha — en chayyayvin aleha mishshum biat mikdash. heve mishshum rabbi yehoshua bar memel gemir la!
Amru, shema minna: kol shemateta demitamra beve telata, kadmae uvatrae — amrinan, metziae — la amrinan.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena, amar nachum hallavlar: kach mekkubbelani merabbi meyasha shekkibbel meabba, shekkibbel min hazzugot, shekkibbelu min hanneviim: halacha lemoshe missinay bezorea shevet vechardal bishnayim ushelosha mekomot, shennoten pea mikkol echad veechad.
Veillu yehoshua vechalev la kachashev. shema minna.

Mishna amar rabbi akiva, danti lifne rabbi eliezer: ma im etzem kisora, sheeno metamme adam beohel — hannazir megalleach al maggao veal massao, reviit dam, shehu metamme adam beohel — eno din sheyyehe hannazir megalleach al maggaah veal massaah?
Amar li: ma ze akiva?! en danin kan mikkal vachomer. ucheshebbati vehirtzeti devarim lifne rabbi yehoshua, amar li: yafe amarta, ella ken amru: halacha.

a: Gemara ibbaya lehu: etzem kisora — halacha, ureviit dam — kal vachomer, veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha.
O dilma: reviit dam — halacha, veetzem kisora — kal vachomer, veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha? ta shema: etzem kisora — halacha, ureviit dam — kal vachomer, veen danin kal vachomer mehalacha.
Hadaran alach kohen gadol

Shene nezirim sheamar lahen echad "raiti echad mikkem shennitma, veeni yodea eze mikkem" — megallechin, umeviin korban tumea vekorban tohora. veomer: im ani hu tame — korban tumea shelli vekorban tohora shellecha, veim ani hu hattahor — korban tohora shelli vekorban tumea shellecha.

Vesofrin sheloshim yom, umeviin korban tohora, veomer: im ani hu hattame — korban tumea shelli vekorban tohora shellecha, veze korban tohorati. veim ani hu hattahor — korban tohora shelli vekorban tumea shellecha, veze korban tohoratcha.
Gemara katane: shene nezirim sheamar lahem "raiti echad mikkem shennitma, veeni yodea eze mikkem". veammay? kol sefek tumea birshut hayyachid mehecha yalfinan le — missota.

Ma sota, boel venivelet, af kol sefek tumea birshut hayyachid, kegon deikka be tere. aval hacha, shene nezirim vehay dekae gabbehon — ha telata, have leh sefek tumea birshut harabbim, vechol sefek tumea birshut harabbim — sefeko tahor!
Amar rabba bar rav huna: beomer "raiti tumea shennizreka benechem". amar rav ashe: dayka name
b: Dekatane "veeni yodea eze mikkem". shema minna.
Megallechin umeviin. veammay? dilma lav temein innun, vekaaved hakkafa! amar shemuel: beishsha vekatan.
Velokma begadol, vehakkafat kol harosh — lo shemah hakkafa! middela mokem la hachi, shema minna kasavar shemuel: hakkafat kol harosh — shemah hakkafa.

Mar zutera matne la leha shemata dishmuel assefa: nazir shehaya tame besafek umuchelat besafek — ochel bekadashim leachar shishshim yom, umegalleach arba tiglachot. veha kaaved hakkafa! amar shemuel: beishsha vekatan.

Amar rav huna: hammakkif et hakkatan hare hu chayyayv. amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerav huna: vedidach man megallach lehon? amar leh: chova. tikberinnun chova livnay. kullehu shene derav adda bar ahava la ikkayyaym leh zara lerav huna.

Mikkedi tarvayyhu sevira hakkafat kol harosh shemah hakkafa, bemay kamippalgi? rav huna, savar "lo takkifu peat roshchem velo tashchit [et] peat zekanecha". kol sheyyesh lo hashechata — yesh lo hakkafa, vehane neshe, hoil veletanhu behashechata — letanhu name behakkafa.

Verav adda bar ahava savar: echad hammakkif veechad hannikkaf bammashma. veittakkash makkif lenikkaf: kol hecha denikkaf michayyayv — makkif name michayyayv. vehay katan, hoil vehu gufeh lav bar uneshin hu demichayyayv, makkif name la michayyayv.
Lema hakkafat kol harosh tannae hi, detanu rabbanan: "rosho", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "lo takkifu peat roshchem",

a: Yachol af metzora ken — talmud lomar: "rosho". vetanya iddach: "rosho", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar gabbe nazir "taar lo yaavor al rosho", yachol af nazir metzora ken — talmud lomar: "rosho".

May lav tannae hi, leman deamar minnazir, kasavar: hakkafat kol harosh — lo shemah hakkafa, vechi ata kera — lemidche et lo taase vaase. veiddach savar: hakkafat kol harosh — shemah hakkafa, vechi ata kera — lemidche lav gereda?

Amar rava: dechulle alma hakkafat kol harosh — lo shemah hakkafa. vechi ata kera, kegon shehikkif ulevassof gillach. kevan deillu gallecheh bechad zimna — la michayyayv, ki hikkif ulevassof gillach — name la michayyayv.
Umi ketav kera hachi? vehaamar resh lakish: kol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase, im atta yachol lekayyem et shenehem — mutav, veim lav, yavo ase veyidche et lo taase.
Ella: dechulle alma hakkafat kol harosh — shemah hakkafa. uman demokem likra lemidche lo taase vaase, lav gereda menaleh?
Yalef miggedilim". deamar kera: "lo tilbash shaatnez", vetanya: "lo tilbash shaatnez", ha "gedilim taase lach" mehem.
Uman denafka leh merosho", may tama la nafka leh miggedilim"? amar lach: lechidrava hu daata.
Derava rame: ketiv "venatnu al tzitzit hakkanaf" — min kanaf, "petil techelet". uchetiv: "tzemer ufishtim yachdav".
Ha chetzad? tzemer ufishtim — potrim ben beminan, ben shello beminan. shear minin — beminan potrin, shello beminan en potrin.
Vehay tanna demappek lerosho" lelav gereda, deate ase vedache et lo taase vaase, menalan? nafka leh mizzekano".
Detanya: "zekano", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu", yachol af kohen metzora ken — talmud lomar: "zekano".
Uman demappek leh lerosho" laase velo taase, lelaf mizzekano"! velitamaych, dekayyma lan bealma
b: Dela ate ase vedache et lo taase vaase, lelaf mikkohen, dedache!
Ella, mikkohen la yalfinan: ma lechohen shekken lav sheeno shave bakkol. nazir mikkohen name la yalef, shekken lav sheeno shave bakkol.
Uman demokem lehay "rosho" benazir, lema li "zekano"?
Mibbee leh, lechidtanya: "zekano" ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu", yachol af kohen metzora ken, talmud lomar: "zekano".
Umenalan divtaar — detanya: "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu", yachol af gillecho bemisparayim yehe chayyayv, talmud lomar: "velo tashchit". i lo tashchit, yachol likketan bemalket uverahitne chayyayv —
Talmud lomar: "ufeat zekanam lo yegallechu". ezo gilluach sheyyesh bo hashechata — heve omer: ze taar.
Uman demappek leh lehay "rosho" lelav gereda, lema li lemichtav "rosho", ulema li lemichtav "zekano"?
Mashma lemidche lav gereda, umashma lemidche lo taase vaase. hilkach shakul hu veyavou shenehen.
Kohen minnazir la yalef, shekken yeshno bishela. nazir mikkohen la yalef, shekken lav sheeno shave bakkol. uvealma la yalfinan minnayyhu, mishshum deikka lemifrach kedaamaran.
Amar rav: mekel adam kol gufo betaar. metivi: hammaavir bet hashshechi uvet haerva — hare ze loke!
Ha betaar, ha bammisparayim. veha rav name betaar kaamar! keen taar.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hammaavir bet hashshechi uvet haerva loke. metivi: haavarat sear enah middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim. may "loke" name dekaamar — midderabbanan.

a: Ikka deamri: amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hammaavir bet hashshechi uvet haerva loke mishshum "lo yilbash gever simlat ishsha". metivi: haavarat sear enah middivre tora ella middivre sofrim. hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: hammaavir bet hashshechi uvet haerva hare ze over mishshum "lo yilbash gever simlat ishsha".

Vetanna kamma, hay "lo yilbash gever", may daresh beh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "lo yihye cheli gever al ishsha". may talmud lomar? im shello yilbash ish simlat ishsha veishsha simlat ish, hare kevar neemar "toeva hi", veen kan toeva.

Ella shello yilbash ish simlat ishsha veyeshev ben hannashim, veishsha simlat ish veteshev ben haanashim. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: minnayin shello tetze ishsha bichle zayin lemilchama — talmud lomar: "lo yihye cheli gever al ishsha velo yilbash gever simlat ishsha", shello yittakken ish betikkune ishsha.
Amar rav nachman: benazir muttar. velet hilcheta kevoteh. amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi shimon bar abba: chazena leh lerabbi yochanan delet leh! amar lehon: mechamat zikna nashru.
Hahu deitchayyayv negida kammeh derabbi amme. iggallay bet hashshechi, chazyeh dela megallach, amar lehon rabbi amme: shivku, den min chavrayya hu.
Bea minneh rav merabbi chiyyay: mahu legalleach? amar leh: asur. amar leh veha ka gadel! amar leh: bar pachate, zeman yesh lo, kol zeman shehu gadel — nosher.
Bea minneh rav merabbi chiyyay: mahu lachoch? amar leh: asur. bevigdo, mahu? amar leh: muttar. ikka deamri, bea minneh: bitfilla bevigdo, may? amar leh: asur. velet hilcheta kevoteh.
b: Mishna met echad mehen, amar rabbi yehoshua: yevakkesh echad min hashshuk sheyyiddor kenegdo benazir.

Veomer: im tame hayiti — hare atta nazir miyyad, veim tahor hayiti — hare atta nazir achar sheloshim yom. vesofrin sheloshim, umeviin korban tumea vekorban tohora. veomer: im ani hu hattame — korban tumea shelli, vekorban tohora shellecha. veim ani hu hattahor — korban tohora shelli, vekorban tumea besafek.

Vesofrim sheloshim yom, umeviin korban tohora, veomer: im ani hattame — korban tumea shelli, vekorban tohora — shellecha, vaze korban tohorati. veim ani hu hattahor — korban tohora shelli, vekorban tumea besafek, vezehu korban tohoratcha.

Amar lo ben zoma: umi shomea lo sheyyiddor kenegdo benazir? ella: mevi chattat haof veolat behema, veomer: im tame hayiti — hachattat mechovati, vehaola nedava. veim tahor hayiti — haola mechovati, vehachattat missafek.
Vesofer sheloshim yom, umevi korban tohora, veomer: im tame hayiti — haola harishona nedava, vezo chova. veim tahor hayiti — haola harishona chova, vezo nedava, vezo shear korbani.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: nimtza ze mevi korbenotav lachatzaim. aval hodu lo chachamim leven zoma.
Gemara velayyte! amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo amar rabbi yehoshua ella lechadded bah et hattalmidim.
Amar rav nachman: may lebed leh rabbi yehoshua ledakkayya dela lesru.
Mishna nazir shehaya tame besafek umuchelat besafek — ochel bekadashim achar shishshim yom.
Veshote yayin, umittamme lammetim achar mea veesrim yom.
Shettiglachat hannega doche tiglachat hannazir bizman shehu vadday. aval bizman shehu safek — eno doche.

a: Gemara tana: bamme devarim amurim — binzirut muetet, aval binzirut bat shana — ochel bekadashim leachar shete shanim,
Veshote yayin umittamme lemetim leachar arba shanim.
Vetane ala: umegalleach arba tiglachiyyot. tiglachat rishona — mevi tzipporim,
Vechattat haof, veolat behema. sheniyya — mevi chattat haof veolat behema, shelishit — mevi chattat haof veolat behema, reviit — mevi korban tohora.
Amarta: tiglachat rishon mevi vechulei. mimma nafshach shappir kamayyte, dei vadday metzora hu velav tame hu — tzipporin chovato, vechattat haof safek, azla likvura, veola havya nedava.
Ulegallecho toch shiva i efshar, dedilma lav muchelat hu, verachamana amar "taar lo yaavor al rosho ad melot".
Vei lav metzora vadday have, vehu tame — chattat haof chovato, vetzipporin abbaray ka mitavdin, vela have chullin baazara. veolat behema havya nedava.
Vei lav metzora hu velav tame hu — tzipporin abbaray ka mitavdin, chattat haof likvura, olat behema havya chovato. veha bae asham! rabbi shimon hi, deamar: mayyte umatne.
Tiglachat sheniyya ushelishit tzipporin la tzerich, deha avayd, may ikka: dilma vadday muchelat hu, chada — lisfek sefaro,
Vachada, lisfek tumeato. tiglachat reviit — mevi korban tohora umatne,
b: Vei vadday nazir hu — ola harishona chova, vezo nedava. veim tame umuchelat hu — ola harishona nedava, vezo chova, veze shear korbano.
Tame safek umuchelat vadday — ochel bekadashim leachar shemona yamim, veshote yayin umittamme lemetim leachar shishshim veshiva yamim.
Muchelat safek vetame vadday — ochel bekadashim leachar sheloshim veshiva yamim, veshote yayin umittamme lemetim leachar shivim vearbaa yamim.
Tame vadday umuchelat vadday — ochel bekadashim leachar shemona yamim, veshote yayin umittamme lemetim leachar arbaim vearbaa yamim.
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi shimon ben yochay: nazir tahor umetzora, mahu sheyyegalleach tiglachat achat veola lo lechan ulechan? amar lahen: eno megalleach.
Amru lo: lamma? amar lahen: illu ze legaddel veze legaddel, veze lehaavir veze lehaavir — yafe attem omrim. achshav, nazir — lehaavir, umetzora — legaddel.

Velo taale lo lime chilluto, vetaale lo lime sefaro! veamar lahen: illu ze lifne zerikat damim veze lifne zerikat damim — yafe attem omrim, ella metzora lifne zerikat damim, venazir leachar zerikat damim.

Velo taale lo lime tzarato uneziruto, vetaale lo lime tzarato vetumeato! amar lahen: illu ze lifne biat mayim veze lifne biat mayim — yafe attem omrim. ella tame leachar biat mayim, metzora lifne biat mayim.
Amru lo: yafe amarta shello taale lo lime sefaro velinziruto, vetaale lo lime chilluto vetumeato, deze legaddel veze legaddel hu!
Amar lahen: nazir tahor vehu metzora — ze legaddel veze lehaavir, veim nazir tame vehu metzora — ze lifne biat mayim veze leachar biat mayim.

a: Tane rabbi chiyyay: ze lifne biat mayim (chayyim) veze leachar biat mayim, ze lifne zerikat damim veze leachar zerikat damim.
Shettiglachat hannega vechulei. bae rame bar chama: hane arba tiglachiyyot dekaamar, mishshum mitzva, o mishshum abore sear tumea?
Lemay nafka minna? leabbore benasha. i amrat mishshum mitzva — leabbore benasha la, vei amrat mishshum abore sear tumea — afillu sachye nasha name.
May? amar rava, ta shema: umegalleach arba tiglachiyyot. i salka datach mishshum abbore sear tumea, afillu beshalosh name sagya leh! shema minna mishshum mitzva: shema minna.
Haderan alach shene nezirim
Haggoyim en lahem nezirut. nashim vaavadim yesh lahen nezirut. chomer bannashim mibbaavadim, shehu kofe et avdo, veeno kofe et ishto.

Gemara katane: haggoyim en lahem nezirut. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan "dabber el bene yisrael" — velo laggoyim. "veamarta alehem" — lerabbot et haavadim. lema li kera? haamrat: kol mitzva shehaishsha chayyevet bah — eved chayyayv bah!
Amar rava: shane hacha deamar kera "lesor issar al nafsho", bemi shennafsho kenuya lo. yatza eved, sheen nafsho kenuya lo. hoil veen nafsho kenuya lo, ema gabbe nazir name la. kamashma lan.

Amar mar: "dabber el bene yisrael", velo laggoyim. vechol hecha dichtiv "yisrael", goyim la? veha gabbe arachin, dichtiv "dabber el bene yisrael", vetanya: bene yisrael maarichin, veen haggoyim maarichin.
Yachol lo yehu neerachin — talmud lomar: "ish".

Shane hacha, deamar kera: "leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma", bemi sheyyesh lo av, yatza goy sheen lo av. lemay? ilema leinyan yerushsha, vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yochanan: goy yoresh et aviv devar tora, shenneemar: "ki yerushsha leesav natatti et har seir"!
Ella bemi shemmuzehar al kibbud aviv. mi ketiv "kabbed avicha" gabbe nazir? ella: amar kera "leaviv uleimmo lo yittamma" — bemi sheyyesh lo tumea,
b: Yatza goy sheen lo tumea. menalan delet lehu tumea? deamar kera: "veish asher yitma velo yitchatta venichreta hannefesh hahi mittoch hakkahal", bemi sheyyesh lo kahal, yatza ze sheen lo kahal.
Mimmay? dilma karet hu dela michayyayv, aval ittammoye mitammu? amar kera "vehizza hattahor al hattame", kol sheyyesh lo tohora — yesh lo tumea, vechol sheen lo tohora — en lo tumea.
Veema: tohora hu dela havya leh, tumea havya leh! amar kera: "veish asher yitma velo yitchatta".
Rav acha bar yaakov amar: shane hacha, deamar kera: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem".
Kol sheyyesh lo nachala — yesh lo tumea, vechol sheen lo nachala — en lo tumea. i hachi avadim name la!
Ella amar rava: bishlama gabbe arachin, shenneemar: "bene yisrael" — bene yisrael maarichin, veen haggoyim maarichin. yachol lo yehu neerachin, talmud lomar: "ish".
Hacha, bene yisrael nozrin umeviin korban, veen haggoyim nozrin umeviin korban. yachol af lo yehu nezirin kelal — talmud lomar: "ish"?
Amri: i mishshum korban lav mehacha nafka leh, ella mehatam: "leola" — perat linzirut, divre rabbi yose haggelili!
Ema: bene yisrael nozrin nezirut olam, veen haggoyim nozrim nezirut olam. yachol lo yehu nezirim — talmud lomar: "ish"! amar rabbi yochanan: mi ketiv "nezir olam"?
Ema: bene yisrael maddirin benehem benazir, veen haggoyim maddirin benehem benazir. yachol lo yehu nezirim — talmud lomar: "ish"! haamar rabbi yochanan: halacha hi benazir.
Ema: bene yisrael megallechin al nezirut avihen, veen haggoyim megallechin al nezirut avihen.

a: Yachol lo yehu nezirin — talmud lomar: "ish"! haittemar amar rabbi yochanan: halacha hi benazir.

I hachi "ish ki yafli neder beerkecha", baarachin, lema li? mikkede haittakkash arachin lindarim, deamar kera "ish ki yafli neder beerkecha", vehatanya gabbe nedarim: "ish". ma talmud lomar "ish ish" — lerabbot et haggoyim shehen nodrim nedarim unedavot keyisrael.
"Ish ki yafli" baarachin lema li? ella hay "ish", mibbee leh leetoye mufela samuch leish.
Hanicha leman deamar mufela samuch leish deorayyta. ella leman deamar derabbanan, "ish ki yafli" lema li? leetoye mufela samuch leish degoy.
Hanicha leman deamar bene yisrael neerachin, veen haggoyim neerachin. yachol lo yehu maarichin, talmud lomar: "ish" — shappir.
Ella leman deamar: bene yisrael maarichim, veen haggoyim maarichim. yachol lo yehu neerachin, talmud lomar: "ish" — afillu tinok ben chodesh bar ayruchi hu, "ki yafli" lema li?
Amar rav adda bar ahava: leetoye goy gadol, deaf al gav degadol hu — eno yodea lehafelot.
Ella: "ki yafli" dichtav rachamana gabbe nezirut, lema li? mikkede haittakkash nezirut lindarim, "ki yafli" lema li?
Leetoye yadayim sheenan mochichot. deittemar: yadayim sheenan mochichot, abbaye amar: havyayn yadayim. rava amar: la havyayn yadayim. leabbaye nicha. ella lerava, may ikka lememar?

Ella: "ki yafli" mibbee leh lechidrabbi tarfon, detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon: en echad mehen nazir, lefi shello nittena nezirut ella lehafelaa. hanicha lerabbi tarfon, ella lerabbanan may ikka lememar?
Ella: mibbee leh lechidtanya: hetter nedarim — porchin baavir, veen lahen al ma sheyyismochu.
Rabbi eliezer omer: yesh lahem al ma sheyyismochu, shenneemar: "ish ki yafli", "ki yafli", shete feamim. echad hafelaa leissur, veechad hafelaa lehetter.
b: Mishna chomer baavadim mibbannashim, shehu mefer nidre ishto, veeno mefer nidre avdo. hefer leishto — hefer olamit. hefer leavdo — yatza lecherut umashlim neziruto.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: lema rabbo kofo? linzirut, aval lo lindarim velaarachin.
May shena gabbe nazir — deamar rachamana "lesor issar al nafsho", bemi shennafsho kenuya lo — yatza eved sheen nafsho kenuya lo. i hachi, afillu gabbe nedarim name!
Amar rav sheshet, hacha bemay askinan: kegon shehaya eshkol shel anavim munnach lefanav. gabbe nedarim, dechi mittesar behay la mittesar beacharine — la matze kafe leh.
Gabbe nezirut, dechi mittesar behay ittesar bechullehu — matze kafe leh. vegabbe nedarim, mi la askinan delekka ella hay eshkol, dei la achel leh, chalesh?
Ella amar rava: kegon shehaya chartzan munnach lefanav. gabbe nedarim, behay hu demittesar — la matze kafe leh. gabbe nazir, deittesar name beachareni — matze kafe leh.
Vegabbe nedarim, mi la askinan delekka ella hay chartzan, dei la achel leh, chalesh?
Ella amar abbaye: lema rabbo tzarich lichpoto — linzirut. veen tzarich lichpoto lindarim, veeno tzarich lichpoto lishvua.
May tama? deamar kera: "lehara o lehetiv", ma hatava reshut — af haraa reshut. yatza lehara laacherim — sheen harshut beyado.
Mishna avar mikkeneged panav, rabbi meir omer: lo yishte, verabbi yose omer: yishte.
Gemara lema bedishmuel kamippalgi, deamar shemuel: hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut, veen tzarich get shichrur.
Rabbi meir it leh dishmuel. rabbi yose let leh dishmuel.

La, dechulle alma it lehu dishmuel. ella: man deamar yishte, savar: sof sof mihdar hadar veate gabbeh, lishte chamra ki hechi dela lichchosh. uleman deamar lo yishte, savar: leheve leh tzara ki hechi delihdar gabbeh.

a: Mishna nazir sheggillach, venoda lo shehu tame, im tumea yedua — soter, veim tumeat tehom — eno soter. im ad shello gillach, ben kach uven kach — soter.
Ketzad? yarad litbol bimara venimtza met tzaf al pi hameara — tame, nimtza meshukka bekarka hammeara,
Yarad lehaker — tahor. littaher mittumeat met — tame. shechezkat tame — tame, vechezkat tahor — tahor, sheraglayim laddavar.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi eliezer, deamar kera: "vechi yamut met alav befeta pitom", "alav" — bimchuvvevret lo.
Resh lakish amar: amar kera "ki yihye tame lanefesh o vederech rechoka". ki derech: ma derech begilluy, af kol begilluy.
Veella haditnan: ezohi tumeat hattehom — kol sheeno makkirah echad besof haolam. aval makkirah echad besof haolam — en zo tumeat hattehom.
Bishlama leman deamar ki derech — shappir. ella leman deamar — bimchuvvevret lo, ki makkirah echad besof haolam may have?
Vetu, ha detanya: hammotze met mushekav lerochbah shel derech, bitruma — tame, benazir uvaasiyyayt pesach — tahor. may shena? ella tumeat hattehom gemara gemiri la.
Im ad shello gillach vechulei. man tanna? amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: tiglachat meakkevet.
Bae rame bar chama: nitma betoch melot venoda lo leachar melot, mahu? batar yedia azlinan, vidia achar melot hi, o la? ulemay: lemistar?
b: Amar rava, ta shema: im ad shello gillach — ben kach uven kach soter. hechi dame? i deityeda leh betoch melot — tzericha lememar? ella lav, leachar melot, shema minna.
Vaadayin tibbee lach: kullo soter o shiva soter? leman? illema lerabbanan — peshita dechullo soter. vei lerabbi eliezer: kol achar melot — shiva soter!
Amar lecha: hane mille, ki nitma achar melot, vehay lifne melot hu. o dilma: shane hacha didia achar melot hi?
Uminna: katane ben kach uven kach soter, vela kamippalgi.
Tanu rabbanan: hammotze met mutal lerochbah shel derech, litruma — tame, uvenazir uveose fesach — tahor. bamme devarim amurim — sheen lo makom laavor,
Aval yesh lo makom laavor — af litruma tahor.
Bamme devarim amurim — shemmetzao shalem. aval meshubbar o meforak, afillu en makom laavor chayyshinan shemma ben pirkin avar. uvekever, afillu meshubbar umeforak — tame, mippene shekkever metzarfo.

Bamme devarim amurim — bimhallech beraglav. aval taun o rachuv — tame. lefi shemmehallech beraglav — efshar lo shello yigga veshello yasit veshello yaahil. taun o rachuv — i efshar shello yigga veshello yasit veshello yaahil.
Bamme devarim amurim — betumeat hattehom. aval tumea yedua — sheloshtan temeim.
Veezo hi tumeat hattehom — kol sheen makkirah echad besof haolam. makkirah echad besof haolam — en zo tumeat hattehom.
Haya tamun beteven o bitzrorot — hare zo tumeat hattehom. bayyammim uvaafela uvinkike hasselaim — en zo tumeat hattehom.
Velo amru tumeat hattehom ella lemet bilvad.
Ketzad yarad. tzafa enah metammea leinyan sheretz, detanya: sefek tumea tzafa, ben bechelim, ben bekarka — tehora. rabbi shimon omer: bechelim temea, bekarka tehora.

a: May tama detanna kamma? amar rabbi yitzchak bar avudimi, ketiv: "bechol hashsheretz hashshoretz", kol makom shehu shoretz, uchetiv "al haaretz". ha ketzad? vadday maggao — tame, sefek maggao — tahor.
Verabbi shimon may tama? amar ulla: ketiv "ach mayan", uchetiv "yitma" (ad haarev), ha ketzad? tzafa bechelim — tame, bekarka — tahor.
Tanu rabbanan: kol hannittalin vehannigrarin — sefekan tame, mippene shehen kemunnachin. vehannizrakin — sefekan tahor.
Chutz min kezayit hammet, vehammaahil al pene tumea, vechol davar shemmetamme millemala kilmatta. leetoye zav vezava.
Bae rame bar chama: met bichli, ucheli tzaf al pene hammayim, mahu? batar keli azlinan, o batar mita azlinan?
Im timtze lomar batar keli azlinan: met al gabbe sheretz, mahu? kevan dehay tumeat erev, vehay tumeat shiva, keman demachata tumea bichli damya, o dilma tumea semichta hi.

Veim timtze lomar keman demachata tumea bichli damya, vetame vadday. sheretz al gabbe nevela, unevela tzafa, mahu? kevan detarvayyhu tumeat erev innun — tumea semichta hi. o dilma: hay kezayit vehay kaadasha?
Sheretz al gabbe sheretz mahu? hane vadday chad shiura ninhu, o dilma kevan demippaski mehadade — la.

Veim timtze lomar: sheretz al gabbe sheretz kevan demippaski mehadade keman demannecha bichli dame, sheretz al gabbe nevela shennimmocha, mahu? kevan denimmocha havya lay mashke, o dilma hay uchela hu.

Veim timtze lomar deuchela hu, sheretz al gabbe shichvat zera, mahu? veim timtze lomar kevan demitakkera havya la ki uchela, sheretz al gabbe me chattat ume chattat tzafin al gabbe hammayim, mahu? la yadinan, teku.
b: Amar rav hamenuna: nazir veose fesach shehalchu bekever hattehom bashshevii shellahen — tehorim. may tama — dela allima tumeat hattehom lemistar.
Metiv rava: yarad littaher mittumeat hammet — tame, shechezkat tame — tame, shechezkat tahor — tahor.
Amar leh: modena lach benazir, shemchussar tiglachat.
Amar leh rava: af ana modena lach beose fesach, dela mechussar vela chelum. amar leh abbaye: veha mechussar heerev shemesh! amar leh: shimsha mimmela arva.
Veaf abbaye hadar beh. detanya:
Yom melot — tavi. toch melot — lo tavi.
Yachol lo tavi al leda shellifne melot, aval tavi al leda shelleachar melot, vetippater mishshetehen —
Talmud lomar: "uvimlot yeme tohora". beyom melot — tavi, toch melot — lo tavi.
Amar rav kahana: shane hacha, dimchassera korban. hatam name, mechassera heerev shemesh!
Amar leh abbaye: shimsha mimmela arva.
Mishna hammotze met battechilla, mushekav kedarko — notlo veet tefusato.
Shenayim — notlan veet tefusatan. matza shelosha, im yesh ben ze laze mearba ammot vead shemone — hare zo shechunat kevarot.

a: Bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma, matza echad besof esrim amma — bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma. sheraglayim laddavar. sheillu techilla metzao — notlo veet tefusato.
Gemara amar rav yehuda: matza — perat lematzuy. met — perat leharug. mushekav — perat leyoshev. kedarko — perat lesherosho munnach ben yarchotav.
Tane ulla bar chanina: met shechasar, en lo tefusa velo shechunat kevarot. vechol hane may tama la? amrinan dilma goy hu.

Matza shenayim, rosho shel ze betzad margelotav shel ze, verosho shel ze betzad margelotav shel ze — en lahen tefusa velo shechunat kevarot. matza shelosha, haechad yadua ushenayim techilla, o shenayim techilla ushenayim yeduim — en lahem tefusa, veen lahem shechunat kevarot.

Maase berabbi yeshevav shebbadak umatza shenayim yeduin veechad techilla, uvikkesh laasotan shechunat kevarot. amar lo rabbi akiva: kol sheyyagata — larik yagata. lo amru shechunat kevarot ella lishlosha yeduin, o lishlosha techilla.
Notlan veet tefusatan. hechi dame tefusa? amar rav yehuda: amar kera "unesatani mimmitzrayim" — tol immi.
Vechamma shiur tefusa? peresh rabbi elazar (berabbi tzadok): notel afar tichuach, vechofer babbetula shalosh etzbaot.
Metivi: vechamma shiur tefusa? peresh rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: notel et hakkesamin veet hakkesasot.
Vezorek et havvavdain umanniach et hassefekot. vehashshear mitztaref lerov binyano shel met, ulerova atzamot, limlo tarvod rakav.
Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: vechamma shiur tefusa? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum ben azzay: notel afar tichuach, vechofer babbetula shalosh etzbaot.
Bodek hemennu.
b: Amar rava: badak ufinna, badak ufinna, bedak veashkach — la hay mefanne leh gabbe hanach tere, vela hane tere legabbay hay chad.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: kevan shennittena reshut lifnot, mefanne lehon. velishavvinhu shechunat kevarot! amar resh lakish: illa, matzu vetiharu eretz yisrael.
Badak meesrim amma velo matza, may? amar rav menashsheya bar yirmeya amar rav: shechunat kevarot. may tama? amar resh lakish: illa matzu vetiharu et eretz yisrael.
Mishna kol sefek negaim battechilla, tahor — ad shello nizkak letumea. mishshennizkak letumea — sefeko tame.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav yehuda amar rav: amar kera "letaharo o letammeo", hoil ufatach [bo] hakkatuv betohora techilla. i hachi, afillu mishshennizkak letumea name sefeko tahor!
Ella, ki ittemar derav yehuda amar rav, aha ittemar: im baheret kadma lesear lavan — tame, veim sear lavan kodem labbaheret — tahor. safek — tame. verabbi yehoshua amar: kiha.
May "kiha"? amar rav yehuda: kiha vetahor. vedilma kiha vetame? amar rav yehuda amar rav: amar kera "letaharo o letammeo". hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv betohora techilla.
Mishna beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav ad shello nizkak leziva: bemaachol uvemishte, bemassa uvikfitza, uvecholi, uvemare, uvehirhur.
Mishshennizkak leziva — en bodkin oto. onso usefeko veshichvat zaro — temeim. sheraglayim laddavar.
Hammakke et chavero vaamaduhu lemita, vehekel mimma shehaya, leachar mikkan hichbid vamet — chayyayv. rabbi nechemya omer: patur, sheraglayim laddavar.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi natan: amar kera "vehazzav et zovo", liriyya shelishit ittakkash linkeva.
Vehatanya, rabbi eliezer omer bashshelishit bodkin oto, barviit en bodkin oto! ella beettim kamippalgi: rabbi eliezer daresh ettim. verabbanan la darshi ettim.
Onso usefeko.
